name: axial spine radiology overview
title: Reading a spine X-ray: after the ABCS sweep, each abnormality has its view, its sign and what it means next: fracture (stable or unstable), facet dislocation, pars defect and spondylolisthesis, scoliosis by Cobb angle, ankylosing spondylitis and sacroiliitis, and prevertebral soft-tissue swelling; normal variants are not disease

root.title: Spine X-ray: which view shows it, what is the sign, and what happens next?
lines: every film, ABCS: Alignment · Bones · Cartilage (disc spaces, facets) · Soft tissues, then the whole image
compare with previous imaging when you have it

groups.title: TRAUMA
lines: most acute trauma gets CT, not X-ray
in a collar: NO oblique views

head: h
Vertebral fracture
compression · wedge · burst · teardrop
look: anterior vertebral · posterior vertebral · spinolaminar · spinous process
next: vertebroplasty (cement): pain relief, does NOT restore height

head: h
Facet dislocation
unilateral or bilateral
next: Cord at risk: MRI + URGENT neurosurgery
the cord cannot be seen on X-ray

head: h
Spondylolysis
defect in the pars interarticularis
look: • COLLAR on the dog's neck = pars defect
~nose transverse process · ear superior facet · leg inferior facet
e.g. L4 on L5, measured in mm

head: h
Scoliosis
sideways curve ± rotation
look: superior endplate of the top tilted vertebra, inferior endplate of the bottom one: angle between the perpendiculars

head: h
Ankylosing spondylitis
spine + sacroiliac joints
next: fractures next to the more mobile segments
bone marrow edema → MRI (X-ray misses it)

head: h
Prevertebral swelling
abscess · trauma · hematoma
look: • wider than the vertebral body at C5–C6
airway smooth and open · air locules

panels.title: Normal variants: do not call them disease
items: limbus vertebra: triangle of bone at the front-top corner (unfused ring apophysis), teens, often L4: NOT a fracture
Schmorl's nodes: endplate dents, usually incidental
cervical rib off C7 (C7 transverse process over ~2–2.5 cm): neck pain, arm pain if it presses the neurovascular bundle

panels.title: Numbers and landmarks
items: atlantodental interval: under 3 mm adults, under 5 mm children (more = instability)
open-mouth view: C1 lateral masses line up with C2
count: T1 meets the 1st rib · L1 sits below the 12th rib
